name: review-buddy
description: AI-assisted narrative code review for Claude Code — Prologue + risk-rated Chapters over a real git diff.

scripts.verify:dist-fresh: git add --intent-to-add -- src/ui/dist dist && git diff --exit-code -- src/ui/dist dist
scripts.verify:prompts-fresh: pnpm gen:prompts && git add --intent-to-add -- integrations && git diff --exit-code -- integrations
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm test:core && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck:core && pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:ui && pnpm test:ui
scripts.verify:ci: pnpm lint && pnpm test:core && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck:core && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:ui && pnpm build:plugin && pnpm test:ui && pnpm verify:dist-fresh && pnpm verify:prompts-fresh && pnpm smoke:plugin
